atAGlance: Bia Tiger is a familiar Southeast Asian lager widely available in Vietnam, useful when you want a straightforward cold beer.
whatItIs: Bia Tiger is Tiger beer served bottled or canned. Expect regional lager that is crisp, lightly bitter, and familiar across Southeast Asia.
howToEnjoy: Order it cold when you want a predictable lager on a mixed menu.
howLocalsOrder: Order Bia Tiger by bottle, can, or bucket if the table is sharing. Ask lạnh or không đá depending on whether you want it cold without ice in the glass.
worthKnowing: Tiger is not uniquely Vietnamese, but it is widely available at casual restaurants, seafood spots, and convenience stores, so it is a useful easy beer order.
